svg.text: libjpeg-turbo cannot split one image across cores, so its all-core rate runs one image per core at a time; the single-image charts show the time for one image.
"In flight": decoders or encoders working at once. The hybrid runs exact-jpeg-metal batches and libjpeg-turbo on the remaining CPU cores; both outputs are exact.
